title: AXSTAD door
description: AXSTAD door, matte blue, 24x20" AXSTAD kitchen door has a matt, blue surface with soft lines and an inset panel. The design allows you to use it to create both a modern and traditional kitchen. Foil gives a smooth and practical surface that is resistant to moisture and staining and is easy to clean.
features: Complete with UTRUSTA 110° hinge with built-in damper for kitchen, 2-pack, sold separately.
Requires a knob or a handle
May be completed with AXSTAD cover panels, plinths and decorative strips in matte blue.
materialAndCare: Main parts: Fiberboard; Front side: Plastic foil (min. 90% recycled); Back side: High-pressure melamine laminate
